sources.title: Do Transformers Actually Help Intrusion Detection? A Temporal Sequence Evaluation on CIC-IDS2017
sources.evidence: Five-tuple windows, final-flow target; split before windowing; skips singleton groups and filters to class intersection. Timestamp selection does not establish completion/arrival availability. v2 separates padding effect from group split effect.
sources.use: Matched-control and split/window protocol review; do not copy its sample deletion or grouping for scans
sources.access: GitHub connector read repo metadata/commit; connector rejected oversized notebook, then Python urllib read the fixed raw notebook in memory only; no notebook executed or retained.

current_stage.priority: Same-input label-granularity three-arm diagnostic before adding historical observations
arms: Normal/AttackA/AttackB hash sham split with the same 4096/512/3584 counts
current_stage.confirmation_gate: Semantic arm must improve over both binary and sham arms before separate confirmation is considered; retain all-attack TP and normal FP constraints.
current_stage.history_branch_condition: Reconsider historical input only if semantic splitting lacks a specific advantage or still fails to improve within-group Scanning-versus-normal ranking; no automatic sequential launch.
current_stage.implementation_status: Design candidate; multiclass adapter and synthetic validation required before laboratory execution
current_stage.compression_status: Deferred until full KV establishes useful task evidence

proposed_measurement_not_claimed_as_new_.status: Conditional fallback design, not the currently selected next laboratory experiment
proposed_measurement_not_claimed_as_new_.history_predicate: same key and query_end - 60000 <= history_end < query_end
proposed_measurement_not_claimed_as_new_.same_timestamp_rule: query entire timestamp batch before inserting any member of that batch
proposed_measurement_not_claimed_as_new_.main_sequence: First perform the same-48-column label-granularity diagnostic. Historical input is reconsidered only after lack of semantic-specific advantage or unresolved within-group ranking; do not automatically run both branches. If history is subsequently selected, retain opened P/C/E for a 52-column diagnostic (48+4 centered zero slots vs 48+4 causal summaries), retain original 48-column B0 as anchor, and require benefit against both before separately considering forward confirmation. Do not change split and information simultaneously.
proposed_measurement_not_claimed_as_new_.window_choice_status: Single preregistered measurement scale informed by minute-level NF3 analysis; not a literature-validated optimum and not tuned on E.
proposed_measurement_not_claimed_as_new_.local_execution: research only; no true-model calls or raw context feature construction
